jobs.title: Meteorologist / Weather Analyst
jobs.description: Work within a top global hedge fund as a Weather Analyst/Meteorologist, applying atmospheric science and data analytics to trading strategies. The role focuses on research into atmospheric predictability, weather models, and fundamental market analysis, directly supporting investment decisions across energy and related products.
requirements: 2+ years of experience as a Weather Analyst/Meteorologist in a buyside or trade shop environment
Strong knowledge of power and energy markets
Proficiency in Python
STEM degree (Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Data Science, or related field)

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Weather and Climate Risks
jobs.description: Join FM’s world-class research team to tackle the pressing challenges of weather and climate risks. You will lead research on extreme weather catastrophes such as tropical cyclones, severe convective storms, and extreme precipitation, contributing to global Climate Risk & Resilience activities and the development of hazard models for wind, flood, storms, and wildfire risks.
requirements: MS in meteorology, data science, or adjacent field with 3+ years professional experience, OR PhD in meteorology, data science, or adjacent field
Strong knowledge of statistical/dynamical downscaling techniques
Experience with global and/or regional climate models and CMIP6 output
Ability to analyze large atmospheric datasets (GeoTIFF, NetCDF, HDF, GRIB)
Proficiency in at least two programming languages (Python, R, Fortran, Matlab)
Strong communication and teamwork skills
skills: GIS (ArcGIS, QGIS, GDAL, Google Earth Engine)

jobs.title: Meteorologist
jobs.company: Department of Commerce – NOAA National Weather Service
jobs.location: Multiple Locations (Anchorage, AK; Mobile, AL; North Little Rock, AR; Miami, FL; and others)
jobs.salary: $40,332 - $90,898 per year (GS-5 to GS-9, promotion potential GS-12)
jobs.description: Meteorologists at the National Weather Service (NWS) provide forecasts, warnings, and advisories for weather and climate hazards. This role involves integrating environmental data, producing impact-based warnings, and providing decision support services to emergency managers and public safety partners. Positions are based in Weather Forecast Offices (WFOs) that operate 24/7, requiring rotating shift work, and are developmental through GS-12 full performance level.
requirements: U.S. Citizenship required

Degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or related natural science with required coursework (atmospheric dynamics/thermodynamics, synoptic/mesoscale analysis, physical meteorology, remote sensing, physics, differential equations, and related sciences)
Specialized experience depending on GS level (use of hydro-meteorological data, forecast preparation, monitoring hazards)
OR equivalent graduate education in Meteorology/Atmospheric Science (Master’s or higher for GS-9)
Ability to obtain/maintain Low Risk Security Clearance

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - Commodities, Weather
jobs.description: Join DRW’s Commodities Weather Team to develop quantitative and systematic trading models that merge commodity fundamentals with weather datasets. You’ll utilize machine learning and statistical techniques, enhance model frameworks, and generate predictive trading signals.
requirements: Master’s or PhD in Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, or related technical field
Strong proficiency in probability, statistics, time series analysis, econometrics, and machine learning
Programming experience in Python or R
Prior exposure to commodities (energy/agricultural) is a plus
Prior exposure to weather data is a plus
Experience in systematic trading is highly advantageous

jobs.title: Consulting Associate, Geospatial Science
jobs.description: Join ERM’s Pacific Northwest team as a Consulting Associate in Geospatial Science, applying GIS and related technologies to environmental impact assessments, planning, permitting, energy infrastructure, and remediation projects. You will design and maintain GIS projects, develop scripts in Python, manage spatial data, and deliver web-based mapping tools for clients.
requirements: Bachelor’s in Geography, GIS, Natural Sciences, or related field (or equivalent experience)
0–1 year of experience in GIS or related work
Experience with Esri ArcGIS Pro suite
Experience designing ArcGIS Online web maps and apps
Strong communication and presentation skills
Must be eligible to work in the U.S. (no sponsorship available)
skills: Field Data Collection (Trimble, Esri mobile apps)

jobs.title: Senior Geoscientist
jobs.description: The Senior Storage Geoscientist will optimize underground natural gas storage assets through advanced subsurface evaluation and geologic modeling. Responsibilities include developing 3D reservoir models, seismic interpretation, salt cavern studies, and supporting both brownfield expansions and greenfield feasibility studies.
requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Geology, Geophysics, or related field
7+ years experience in underground gas storage or related industry
Proficiency in geoscience software (Petrel, Kingdom, or similar)
Experience with seismic interpretation and reservoir property modeling
Strong collaboration and technical communication skills

jobs.title: Geospatial Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Attis seeks a Geospatial ML Engineer to develop and deploy algorithms for satellite and geospatial data analysis. This 8–12 month W2 contract role focuses on building AI-driven solutions to support climate resilience and infrastructure. You will lead projects from data exploration through delivery, with opportunities for extension.
requirements: 6+ years commercial experience as Data Scientist or ML Engineer
Extensive experience with geospatial/satellite data and libraries (GDAL, Rasterio, GeoPandas, QGIS)
Proficiency in Python (NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, etc.)
Experience with deep learning (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
Must be U.S.-based (Citizen or Green Card holder)

jobs.title: Research Geophysicist
jobs.description: As part of Viridien’s Subsurface Imaging team, the Research Geophysicist will design innovative solutions for seismic imaging and inversion challenges. You will develop signal processing and wave propagation algorithms, collaborate on HPC applications for GPU/CPU architectures, and publish findings in industry venues.
requirements: PhD or Master’s in Geophysics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related field
Excellent coding skills in C/C++, CUDA, FORTRAN, Python, or OpenCL
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Knowledge of geophysical concepts and seismic imaging/inversion preferred
Experience with HPC (MPI, GPU computing) highly desirable
Must have U.S. work authorization

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Leidos seeks a Data Scientist to join its advanced signal processing and data analytics group in San Diego. This role supports national defense projects through the design of ML-driven solutions in physics domains including hydrodynamics, acoustics, and RF/EO/IR propagation.
requirements: Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years relevant experience OR Master’s with 2+ years
Experience in developing and implementing machine learning solutions
Proficiency in C/C++, Python, or Matlab
Strong knowledge of ML concepts, algorithms, and data exploration techniques
Must be U.S. citizen eligible for Top Secret clearance
